m.t: Solo está tratando de meterse en nuestras cabezas.
m.e: He's just trying to get in our heads.

m.t: Este país es como meterse en la Biblia.
m.e: This country is like stepping into the Bible.

m.t: Este chip puede meterse en cualquier sistema en el planeta, incluyendo el nuestro.
m.e: This card can hack into any system on the planet, including ours.

m.t: Lo suficiente como para meterse en la cama con su familia insurgente.
m.e: Enough to get in bed with her insurgent family.

m.t: Solo trata de meterse en tu cabeza, minar tu deseo de luchar con ella.
m.e: Just trying to get in your head, undermine your will to fight her.

m.t: Así que intente no meterse en líos.
m.e: So try to keep yourself out of trouble.

m.t: Vamos a meterse en la cama 3.
m.e: Let's get him in Bed 3.

m.t: - No pueden meterse así en mi casa.
m.e: - You can't walk into my house like this.

m.t: Tom está corriendo el riesgo de meterse en problemas.
m.e: Tom is running the risk of getting himself in trouble.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2057134 by hayastan; English translation #1994438 by CK

m.t: Es obligatorio ducharse antes de meterse en la piscina.
m.e: You must shower before entering the pool.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6568662 by arh; English translation #9966161 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: ¡Necesitan meterse en una bolsa!
m.e: They need to stuff themselves in a bag!

m.t: Tom se arriesgó a meterse en problemas por mí.
m.e: Tom risked getting in trouble for me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2170119 by hayastan; English translation #1994432 by CK

m.t: Tom experimentó una fuerte presión de sus compañeros para meterse en drogas cuando era un adolescente.
m.e: Tom experienced strong peer pressure to dabble in drugs when he was a teenager.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6046988 by albrusgher; English translation #3746393 by patgfisher

m.t: Ya nadie quiere meterse en este negocio sucio.
m.e: No one wants to go into this dirty business anymore.

m.t: Pueden meterse en un verdadero problema por esto, lo saben, ¿verdad?
m.e: You can get into real trouble over this one, you know that, right?

m.t: Esos piratas eligieron meterse con el tipo equivocado.
m.e: Those pirates picked the wrong guy to mess with.

m.t: Tom trató de meterse a la habitación cerrada con llave.
m.e: Tom tried to get into the locked room.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1840539 by marcelostockle; English translation #1092633 by CK

m.t: - Acaba de meterse allí.
m.e: - She just went in there.

m.t: ¿A que no hay cojones a meterse con él?
m.e: What, no one has the guts to mess with him?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1616598 by teskmon; English translation #9706421 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Los que hablan mucho suelen meterse en problemas.
m.e: A person who speaks too much often gets into trouble.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10848781 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #7049904 by tiziri

m.t: En líneas generales, los periodistas no vacilan en meterse en la vida privada de uno.
m.e: By and large, reporters don't hesitate to intrude on one's privacy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1627589 by teskmon; English translation #21824 by AlanF_US

m.t: Eso es lo que te hacen, hombre... intentan meterse en tu cabeza.
m.e: That's what they do to you, man. They're trying to get in his head.

m.t: Mire, Hermana, no quiere meterse conmigo.
m.e: Look, sister... you don't want to fuck with me.
